envelope.description: A waiting message's attachments survive the start-up sweep

body.title: A waiting message's attachments survive the start-up sweep
body.summary: Add tests only: the start-up sweep over a keep set made from the store's sessions keeps the attachments directory of a session that holds a waiting queued message and clears an unreferenced old session; and a queued message with an attachment keeps it and sends it when the message runs. Show the sweep test can fail: temporarily build the keep set without the stored session and see the directory removed, then restore it. No production change is planned; if the tests show the keep set does not protect the session, that is reported, not worked around.
acceptanceChecks: the sweep keeps the attachments of a stored session with a waiting message and removes an unreferenced old one, and the same test fails when the stored session is left out of the keep set
a queued message with an attachment still has it and sends it when it runs

tests.name: attachment-store.test.ts: the start-up sweep keeps the attachments of a session in the keep set that holds a waiting message and clears an unreferenced old session
chat-queue-outbox-host.test.ts: a queued message with an attachment keeps it and sends it when the message runs
